discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has gone from basic incretin discovery to drugs that changed the treatment of diabetes and obesity and lowered cardiovascular and kidney risk. It has won the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prizes, and the recent Medicine prizes (mRNA, microRNA, Tregs) did not cover metabolism, so the field is open and due.
